scope: Phase 2 of the 2026-11-09 review follow-up: a dev-only app portal origin. The existing portal runs prod apps only; dev (unapproved) app code never shares a JavaScript origin with prod apps. localhost and single-IP (port-separated) installs are the default; hostnames are optional. Source implementation and isolated validation only; production is not changed by this record.

decisions.decision: Add a dev-only portal origin; the existing portal becomes prod-only.
Design for open-source installs without a domain: localhost or one IP, port-separated origins.
Production address and the production transition are confirmed by the user after this validation is reported.

changes: Core: BrowserPurpose::DevPortal (serde snake_case dev_portal), helpers portal()/environment(); required MIY_DEV_PORTAL_ORIGIN and MIY_DEV_PORTAL_BIND_ADDR; three distinct same-transport origins, identity issuer never on a portal origin; a third fixed loopback listener.

Policy: one check in Facts::decide limits a portal session to Use in prod and a dev portal session to Use in dev, covering app APIs, UI assets, directory, connections, lists and canOpen. Bearer (CLI/MCP/preview/continuation) principals are unchanged.
Boundary: the dev portal listener serves only public sign-in, /me and portal (app) routes, and refuses every bearer credential.
Migration 0021_dev_portal.sql widens the three browser_purpose CHECK constraints only (no data change); older binaries keep working on schema 21.

Web: surface dev_portal with devPortalOrigin validation; prod portal sends dev and legacy /apps paths to the dev portal before sign-in or app import; per-environment origins for the environment switch and console links; a server without devPortalOrigin keeps the old two-origin behaviour so the UI can ship before the server transition.

Ops: bootstrap.py (dev portal origin/bind/ports, Keycloak callback and logout URIs, web origins unchanged), render-server-config.py (third Nginx server block), Caddy (devportal snippet), compose.yaml, configure-identity.py, check-server-config.py, check-server-tls.py, check-http-server.py, check-platform-connection.mjs, up.sh, stack-ui.sh, server-ui.mjs.

Rollout: core-rollout.py --widen-migration (pinned 0021 bytes; backup restore and migrate rehearsal first; rollback keeps schema 21); new scripts/dev-portal-settings.py for additive settings/identity/Nginx steps with restore, plus offline tests.

Tests: policy, domain, boundary unit tests; boundary, permissions and migration (19->20->21) regressions with three listeners; mocked and real-core UI specs moved to the dev portal; new redirect, configuration and pre-split compatibility UI tests.
Docs: APP-BOUNDARIES (three origins, enforcement, limits, status), CORE-PERMISSIONS, PRD, PLAN, CHECKS, RUNNING, SERVER-OPERATIONS (staged transition), AGENTS.

limitations: Same-host port separation shares cookies: dev code can still plant a portal session cookie when none exists (login CSRF) or flood cookies; hostnames are recommended where a domain exists.
Until the production transition, the existing portal still runs dev and prod apps together.
